applicable_conditions: When scoring evidence is missing or conflicting but official score is valid and execution succeeded.
When comparing runs that differ in air tactics parameters while surface attack results are identical.
When weapon release attribution is unknown and hit/kill counts are inconsistent.
counter_conditions: If additional evidence becomes available with complete attack-wave mapping and attribution, the hypothesis may be revised to a causal claim.
If repeated runs show identical J-15 outcomes across all variations, the association may be spurious.
If the runtime environment changes, results may not transfer.
hypothesis: Changed StrategySpec fields such as ingress_altitude_m and launch_delay_seconds may be associated with variations in J-15 survival and attack success, but the evidence is insufficient to establish a causal mechanism.

recommended_pattern.summary: Conduct a controlled follow-up experiment: run the same scenario multiple times with identical seeds except for one changed air-tactics field at a time (e.g., sortie 0 ingress altitude only), and record J-15 survival and attack participation. Compare distributions across runs to assess whether the field has a systematic effect, while acknowledging that random variation in defensive actions may confound results.
